question: How is the end of a chunked message body signalled?

claims.text: RFC 9112 Section 7.1 states that the chunked transfer coding is complete when a chunk with a chunk-size of zero is received, possibly followed by a trailer section, and finally terminated by an empty line.
RFC 9112 Section 8 states that a message body using the chunked transfer coding is incomplete if the zero-sized chunk that terminates the encoding has not been received.
